answer.rationale: Write-path p99 is 5x and isolated to the primary region while settlement writes are at daily peak; compliance forbids reverting the security release, and shedding via a circuit breaker would drop customer writes. Inherited memory_b2 is the closest match (regional degradation restored by a clean traffic shift). memory_b5 is the other plausible write-latency lever (offload reads from the primary) and should be checked before committing, because the regional-only symptom is not yet proven to be the same failure mode as March. Capacity-add is weaker mid-peak and does not address a region-scoped fault. Prefer failover to keep writes flowing, but treat settlement-path dual-write/consistency risk as open until the archives are reviewed.
